“Just keep moving,” she muttered under her breath, the words barely breaking the silence. It was a mantra, an incantation against the creeping dread that had followed her since she’d left the warmth of the café. The clatter of her boots against the stones sounded louder than it should, each step a reminder of her isolation. She could almost hear her heartbeat, a steady drum in her ears as she quickened her pace.
